title: Do we really only use 10% of our brain? 🧠
description:
The 10% brain myth, busted: scans show activity all over the brain, and a 2% organ that burns 20% of your energy isn't sitting idle.

Sources:
https://www.livescience.com/health/neuroscience/do-we-really-use-only-10-of-our-brains
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ten-percent-of-the-brain_myth
https://www.sciencefocus.com/author/deanburnett/news/myth-use-10-per-cent-brain

humour.trend: 'Always Has Been' format (rising on Imgflip this week), as a text card

speaker: ved

scenes.say: You've heard you only use *ten percent* of your brain.

scenes.say: Your brain is just *2%* of your weight, but it burns about *20%* of your energy.

scenes.say: Think of a city at night. Not every light is on at once...
...but over a day, every neighbourhood gets *busy*.
The ten percent idea? Probably a *1936* self-help book, misquoting a *Harvard* psychologist.

scenes.say: So there's no secret ninety percent to unlock. You already use *all of it*.
